ADVISOR IMPLEMENTATION RULING — TASK-2345, within existing approved scope.
Accept codex2's source-grounded diagnosis and bounded pure-fact proposal (/tmp/codex2-task2345-diagnosis.txt; canonical diagnostic). The four current native-session failures are contaminated inputs, not permission to weaken privacy or change expected values to the developer's actual handle.
Implement collector→pure inbox_identities_from_facts with production ancestry/registry/catalog/env resolution retained in one collector. Pure composition must not call native/environment/catalog lookups again. Keep precedence, normalization/dedup, intentional known-human and shared role/vendor behavior, private current-session binding and inherited-parent exclusion. No production environment switch, externally selectable fake identity, registry deletion, real cwd/process-tree alteration or grant/authority change.
Use the same explicit facts for internal urgent-count IO and full awaiting-report mail composition/supplier; production public wrappers retain signatures and feed real facts. Preserve ctx.role-before-env-role precedence. The injected full-report path must not re-enter inbox_identities/current_session_handle_for_cwd indirectly. Keep unrelated report channels and current receipt/watermark behavior unchanged; B's later post-flush ACK changes do not belong in A preparation.
Retain exact no-session solo-user/union, urgent1→0 and own0/shared3/shared_scope advisor assertions from synthetic facts. Repair coincidentally passing canonical/type mail cases using this same seam. Add child versus inherited-parent aliases, intentional known human/shared, no binding, same-session/native-resume, role alias and dedup cases. Retain real child/native privacy wrapper regressions; pure tests alone do not prove integration.
Trace and commit this as TASK-2345, independently reviewable from BUG2017 admission/fixture changes. If included in an existing PR, explicitly extend its Refs/description and review scope; do not silently claim the entire STORY1843 or mark this task complete before coverage/review/integration. Use normal AIDA claim/scope handling; no grant/scope bypass if refused. Existing BUG2222 next-safe-checkpoint fleet-unblock priority remains; this is the approved bounded repair when returning to identity fixtures, not a second competing implementation.
Local verification: one meaningful affected-module filtered run/new pure cases plus fast; touched/compile only as required by shared infrastructure or>10files. Preserve actual final failures rather than recording partial logs as pass; no blind repeated whole suite, Cargo slot bypass or nested timeout. No live mail/ACK/migration tests. Codex1 retains implementation ownership; codex2 remains independent reviewer.
subject: TASK2345 bounded fact-seam repair approved; preserve BUG2222 ordering
